objective: Acquire reproducible decision-time historical bid/ask truth, classify gaps without interpolation, and rerun the frozen multi-bar admission contract.

scope.rule: Do not silently expand the pair allowlist. Report both eligible-pair and all-251 coverage denominators.

source_contract.primary_execution_source: OANDA v20 actual ledger outcomes and existing bid/ask fill truth
source_contract.primary_limitation: OANDA complete means only that candle end is not in the future; it does not prove gapless historical ticks.
source_contract.secondary_feature_source: Dukascopy official historical tick export/datafeed, stored with a separate source boundary
source_contract.secondary_use: pre-entry price-action features only; never substitute a Dukascopy price for an OANDA fill
source_contract.price_type: best bid and best ask tick

gap_contract.MARKET_CLOSED: America/New_York Friday 17:00 through Sunday 17:00, or an explicit source schedule/holiday closure
gap_contract.RAW_NO_TRADE_INTERVAL: no tick in a five-second bucket inside a fully downloaded and structurally valid source hour; previous source tick may be carried only as an explicitly flagged bar-construction operation
gap_contract.ACQUISITION_DEFECT: HTTP/decompression/schema/monotonic/bid-ask failure or an unavailable required market-open hour

feature_contract.timestamp: 48 completed M5 bars ending strictly before feature_at_utc
feature_contract.M5: deterministic aggregation of 60 lineage-bearing S5 buckets
features: mid returns over 1, 3, 12 and 48 completed M5 bars
range position within prior 12 and 48 bars
distance from prior 12 and 48 bar high and low
median spread bps over prior 12 and 48 bars
range expansion over fixed 3 versus 12 bars

evaluation.split: unchanged chronological 60/40 with one-hour embargo and close-time purge
evaluation.baseline: all trades on the identical full validation cohort
acceptance: validation after-cost net strictly above all-trades
stable positive incremental result on evaluable 32d and 64d windows

library_contract.independent_oracle: stdlib-only raw/schema/hash checks plus independent metric recomputation
